structural_change: S81-MUBUF3 10-19 structural successor of s81sl_lepmua_b64 (GPL-0305 NaN, routability inflation ~170% in the 64.8 um band) and of the _sf 32.4 um band (DPL): every central-band kit forces all logic for 20 SRAMs (8,740 macro signal pins on their W/E faces) and 6.9k face pins through one strip; the y=324 cut alone carries ~5.7k macro + 2.2k N-face nets vs ~3.3k vertical M3/M5 tracks (2.4x). Fix: NO row pruning and NO GPL row envelope -- standard full-core rows with 10.8 um macro halos, so the interface/pin flops sit beside the macro faces and face pins they serve (every row between macro rows is full width, PDN-connected; no islands). Macros back on the _sf 43.2 lattice rows (TX 43.2..388.8 @86.4, RX 475.2/518.4), outline 475.2x561.6 (was 604.8), std_area = synthesis area. RTL/params/benches identical to the b64 kit (IN_PIPE=1, 6 kept vcopy).
